chosen.description: the IDs of the chosen options

available.description: questions a quiz could show now: not shown in the last 7 days

back_at.description: when the first resting question can be shown again

easier.description: available questions predicted easier than the target

harder.description: available questions predicted harder than the target

near_level.description: available questions at the learner's level (within the fit window of the target)

quiz_length.description: questions in the next quiz; 0 when a quiz can't start

resting.description: questions shown in the last 7 days

writing.description: Claude is writing questions for this topic now

open_quiz.description: the latest quiz, when it isn't finished

spark.description: Elo at the end of each day with answers, over the last 30 days, oldest first

missed_in.description: subtopics with wrong answers, most first

previous.description: the topic's check before this one, if any

location.description: Where the error occurred, e.g. 'body.items[3].tags' or 'path.thing-id'

value.description: The value at the given location

detail.description: A human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence of the problem.
examples: Property foo is required but is missing.

errors.description: Optional list of individual error details

instance.description: A URI reference that identifies the specific occurrence of the problem.

title.description: A short, human-readable summary of the problem type. This value should not change between occurrences of the error.

type.description: A URI reference to human-readable documentation for the error.

pending_job.description: a job that is still queued or running, if any

reply.description: the assistant's message once the job is done

topic.description: slug of the topic a button press asked Claude to write for; empty for typed messages

failed.description: Claude's message about a job that failed; the job can be retried

job_id.description: the job this message asked for or answered

kind.description: request: a button press such as Write 15, shown as a system card

due_at.description: from when it comes back: the next quiz in this topic

hits.description: times the learner has made this mistake

new.description: the first time the learner fell for a trap Claude wrote, so it's new on their list

next_check.description: which of the 5 checks comes next, 1 to 5; 0 when done

next_due.description: from when it comes back; null when done

needs_questions.description: no unseen question tests this mistake yet

mistake.description: the mistake this wrong option stands for, or empty

on_list.description: the mistake is one the learner has made, not only a trap Claude wrote

chosen.description: the option IDs the learner chose on that question

order.description: the option IDs in the order they were shown, so A, B, C… mean what the learner saw

page.description: the page the chat was opened on

moved_on.description: mistakes that moved a step towards done

answers_in_topic.description: the learner's answers in this topic so far, this one included

moved_on.description: mistakes this right answer moved a step towards done

p.description: the predicted chance of a right answer

options.description: in the order they were shown

model.description: the Claude model that writes questions

target.description: the predicted chance of success questions are aimed at

thin.description: even the closest question was more than 0.15 off the target

id.description: the option's original index; send it back when answering

kind.description: practice, or a skill check that measures you

length.description: the most questions it will ask; a check may stop earlier

claude.description: the Claude CLI version in the runner

last_error.description: the error of the last chat job, if it failed

came_back.description: mistakes the learner made again in this quiz

check.description: a finished skill check's result; null for practice

margin_after.description: ± Elo points after the quiz's last answer

moved_on.description: mistakes this quiz moved a step towards done

off_level.description: answered questions outside the learner's usual range, because none closer were left
